scope: Editorial titles, captions and alternative text only. The original capture manifest, image files, crops and scientific content are unchanged.

images.title: The response between ports
images.caption: Review the complex S matrix at each calculated frequency, then open the corresponding plots from the same project.
images.alt: Stepped Impedance Quick Tour project showing a complex two-port S matrix and buttons for Cartesian, Smith and field views.
images.detail: Each matrix cell relates an outgoing port response to a configured excitation. The screenshot shows the selected 2.8 GHz sample.

images.title: The geometry used for calculation
images.caption: Inspect the conductor volumes used by the solver alongside the editable geometry list before running a calculation.
images.alt: 3D conductor volumes and editable geometry list for the shielded Stepped Impedance Quick Tour structure.
images.detail: The shielded structure extends beyond the original viewport. Its color identifies geometry; it does not represent a metal-loss calculation.

images.title: Reflection and transmission
images.caption: Compare input reflection S(1,1) and forward transmission S(2,1) magnitude in dB across the available frequency samples.
images.alt: Cartesian plot of S(1,1) reflection and S(2,1) transmission magnitude in dB, with three frequency samples joined by straight segments.
images.detail: Straight segments connect the available samples. Invalid samples remain visible gaps, not interpolated results.

images.title: Input reflection and impedance
images.caption: Follow diagonal reflection S(1,1) on the Smith chart and read Gamma and normalized input impedance at the selected frequency.
images.alt: Smith chart showing the S(1,1) reflection trace with a 900 MHz marker, Gamma and normalized impedance readouts.
images.detail: The selected marker is 900 MHz. Normalized impedance readouts apply only to diagonal reflection terms. This capture and the matrix use different selected frequencies.

images.title: Magnetic field component Hy
images.caption: Inspect where the signed Hy component varies across the structure. Shown in A/m at saved step 8192 on Z slice 9.
images.alt: Magnetic field viewer displaying signed Hy in A/m at saved step 8192 on Z slice 9, with axes and a signed color scale.
images.detail: Select a saved job, component, time step and slice to inspect the spatial distribution. This image shows a magnetic field component, not total field magnitude.

images.title: Electric field component Ez
images.caption: Locate the concentration of the signed Ez component in a cross-section. Shown in V/m at saved step 768 on Y slice 10.
images.alt: Electric field viewer displaying signed Ez in V/m at saved step 768 on Y slice 10, with axes and a signed color scale.
images.detail: Select a saved job, component, time step and slice to inspect the spatial distribution. This image shows an electric field component, not total field magnitude.
